narrative.overview:
Mapletrace pairs a dark moss workspace with a faint warm paper canvas and paper evidence cards. Sage marks the main action and active focus; amber marks open questions. The visual language keeps the board distinctive while making the review path easy to scan during a short demo.

Typography controls, search, and the primary demo action should remain easy to find. The inspector puts original sources first, and graph and list views provide two ways to inspect the same evidence. Scores are labeled illustrative wherever shown.
keyCharacteristics: Dark moss workspace with a faint warm paper evidence surface.
Paper-toned pinned cards with restrained accent colors.
Sources and uncertainty are visible parts of the review flow.

rules.name: The Evidence-State Rule
rules.body: Use sage for interaction and amber for questions; keep observed records legible on paper-toned cards.

rules.name: Legible handwriting and threads
rules.body: Keep evidence-card text upright, with handwriting on titles, summaries, question links, and thread annotations; use sans-serif metadata. Omit inset frames, footer dividers, and visible Inspect copy. Keep an accessible arrow-only inspection button. Keep at least 40px between settled cards. Smooth 3px red threads attach to facing edges against faint paper. Keep handwritten connection labels quiet and unboxed, wrapping only at spaces. Arrowheads require explicit API direction; unknown or undirected relationships use plain threads. Claims and inferences remain dashed and explicitly labeled. The minimap reuses note silhouettes, inset top pins, facing-side curves, explicit direction, and selection; use a light viewport wash.

dos: Do keep the main demo action visually prominent and controls readable.
Do pair graph inspection with a searchable list view.
Do label illustrative scores and keep questions distinct from observed evidence.
Do keep source inspection near the item being reviewed.
donts: Don't use amber question styling as proof that a claim is true.
Don't imply that illustrative scores or placeholder hashes are computed results.
Don't rely on the remote font request without the declared system fallbacks.
